newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks make small, cautious gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks make small, cautious gains.

text.p: Wall Street shares were slightly higher but analysts said the stock market was wary after its recent volatile swings.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up around 15 points at 7705, after opening lower and occasionally drifting down.
The Nasdaq composite, which had been dragged down by several earnings warnings from the technology sector, managed to push higher. It rose around one point to 1447.
The long bond was off 6/32 to yield 6.75 percent -- above session lows. Earlier, a drop in jobless claims spooked bonds.
